content.text:
## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 1f1b516171664d26669bc59009aefd81aaa76a17

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log --follow -p` on `StudentSectioningDatabaseLoader.java` and searched for the exact line modified by the fix (`section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course))`). This surfaced exactly two commits touching that line: the fix commit itself (`df2beb076`) and an earlier commit `1f1b51617` (2017-06-20), which is where the line was originally added (there was no prior version of this loop to blame further back — `git show` confirms it as a pure addition, `+2` lines, no removal).

**(2) The introducing change:** Commit `1f1b51617` added:
```java
for (CourseOffering course: io.getCourseOfferings())
    section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course));
```
without any null-check on the result of `c.getClassSuffix(course)`. The fix commit `df2beb076` adds exactly that missing guard:
```java
String suffix = c.getClassSuffix(course);
if (suffix != null)
    section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), suffix);
```

**(3) Supporting evidence:** `Class_.getClassSuffix(CourseOffering)` (JavaSource/org/unitime/timetable/model/Class_.java:1672-1673) delegates to `ExternalClassNameHelperInterface`, and the default implementation (`DefaultExternalClassNameHelper.getClassSuffix`) returns `clazz.getClassSuffix()` — a plain nullable field. So for course offerings where the class has no suffix, this call legitimately returns `null`, and the original 2017-06-20 code passed that `null` straight into `section.setName(...)`, which the later fix explicitly guards against. This is a direct, self-contained root cause with no other plausible contributing commits found in the history of this line.

I'm fairly confident in this identification since the diff addition is isolated to a single commit and the fix precisely reverses/guards the exact defect in that commit.
